public_rationale: On February 29, 2024, Reuters, citing the Wall Street Journal's February 28 report, described an ongoing SEC investigation into whether OpenAI investors were misled [e1]. The report described records requests, a December subpoena to OpenAI, and document-preservation requests to senior executives, supporting the claim that OpenAI was under investigation during February 28–29, 2024 [e1]. Reuters reported that the SEC declined to comment [e1].
limitations: No public SEC confirmation was located.
Reuters attributes the investigation to the Wall Street Journal; it is not a second independent confirmation.
The report does not establish misconduct by OpenAI or its executives.
The timing relative to Marcus's previous newsletter was not verified.

criteria.support_condition: A public SEC record or credible contemporaneous reporting establishes an active SEC investigation concerning OpenAI during February 28–29, 2024.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable contemporaneous records or a substantiated correction establish that the reported investigation did not exist or concerned a different entity or regulator.
